import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

grand_total = 0.0
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
    if numeric.shape[1]:
        print("Column sums:")
        for col in numeric.columns:
            print(f"  col {col}: {numeric[col].sum()}")
        sheet_total = float(numeric.to_numpy().sum())
        print(f"Sheet numeric sum: {sheet_total}")
        grand_total += sheet_total
    else:
        print("No numeric columns")

print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (all numeric cells, all sheets): {grand_total}")
